entities.name: Ljubo Babić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ljubomir Tito Stjepan Babić was a Croatian artist, museum curator and literary critic. As an artist, he worked in a variety of media including oils, tempera, watercolour, drawing, etching, and lithography. He was one of the most influential figures in the Zagreb art scene between the two world wars.
